test_title: PYST 03: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: L, A, N, T, E, R, and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). L sits third to the right of E. E sits second to the right of T. S sits third to the left T. N sits third to the left of A. Who is sitting to the immediate left of A?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) L sits third to the right of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54e99b47b0af0c87ae21088e7fde3bf32ad8fb6447a531d3fd7ecbc5797344ba.png] 

2) E sits second to the right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/154e49a67b85ab3fcca76648c4a8644be7e762ef012ae75f6348bb06207ccd78.png] 

3) S sits third to the left T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2576748c2cabe4b005f05aa3d3fa18cf72943e559d62f785146228c1be4f7bbc.png] 

4) N sits third to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2b7bb3b750777cdbd659323fe3240150543d58d93683b6496462b32f14ed1c4.png] 

Here, we can see that L is sitting to the immediate left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"L"**.
